svg.title: Where the pieces sit: the photo goes through the vision tower and the projector, the ids through embed_tokens, the merge returns the sequence, the mask and the position ids, and the language model scales the sequence, runs 18 decoder layers, a final norm and lm_head, which shares its matrix with embed_tokens

g.text: the language model joins the pieces of the earlier chapters
every part now holds trained weights, except self_attn
